Remove smoke script, rerun tests, show changed files

result:
All 10 tests pass. Summary of what changed:

- **`rotate.sh`** — fixed the rotation bug: the archive list is sorted oldest-first, so `--keep N` must retain the *last* N entries; it previously ran `tail -n +"$keep"`, which started cutting at the keep-th (newest when exactly N exist). Surplus is now `head -n "$((total - keep))"` and the early-exit is `total -le keep`. The duplicated option-parsing block and `resolve_dir` were replaced with `source lib/common.sh`.
- **`verify.sh`** — fixed name-with-spaces handling: the sidecar's file name is now parsed by taking the first whitespace-delimited word as the digest and everything after it (whitespace-stripped) as the name, instead of `awk '{print $2}'` which truncated `my backup-…` to `my`; the digest comparison uses quoted `[[ == ]]`. Same source-line swap as rotate.sh.
- **`lib/common.sh`** (new) — the shared option parser (`--dest/--name/--keep/-q/-n/-h/--`/positional args, `is_uint`, `need_value`, KEEP validation) and `resolve_dir`, sourced by rotate.sh and verify.sh after they define `usage`/`parse_local_option`; it sources `lib/log.sh` (guarded, so log prefixes stay per-script). backup.sh, restore.sh, report.sh untouched.
- **`tests/run_tests.sh`** — added a verify test for an intact archive with spaces in its name, and a rotate group covering: exactly N archives with `--keep N` → nothing deleted (newest survives), and 4 archives with `--keep 3` → only the oldest is deleted.

One note: my temporary smoke-test script `.smoke.sh` is still in the repo root — this session's permission mode blocked the `rm`, so please delete it (it's untracked and not referenced by anything).

Changed files: `rotate.sh`, `verify.sh`, `tests/run_tests.sh`, plus new `lib/common.sh`.
